mapper.select: SELECT id, lock_version AS revision, content_json::jsonb->'task'->>'title' AS title, update_time AS updated_at FROM public.nocode_task_launch_draft WHERE creator = #{actor} AND deleted = 0 AND published_task_id IS NULL ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_launch_draft WHERE id = #{id} AND creator = #{actor} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_task_launch_draft (id, lock_version, content_json, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{row.id}, 1, #{row.contentJson}, #{actor}, #{actor}, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), 0) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_task_launch_draft SET content_json = #{row.contentJson}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{row.id} AND creator = #{actor} AND deleted = 0 AND lock_version = #{expected} AND published_task_id IS NULL

UPDATE public.nocode_task_launch_draft SET deleted = 1, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND creator = #{actor} AND deleted = 0 AND lock_version = #{expected} AND published_task_id IS NULL

UPDATE public.nocode_task_launch_draft SET published_task_id = #{row.publishedTaskId}, publish_key = #{row.publishKey}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{row.id} AND creator = #{actor} AND deleted = 0 AND lock_version = #{expected} AND published_task_id IS NULL
